content: We found that an ASR system trained on unbalanced data regarding gender produces gender bias performance. Therefore, in order to create fair systems it is necessary to take into account the representation problems in society that are going to be encapsulated in the data. Understanding how women under-representation in broadcast data can lead to bias in ASR performances is the key to prevent re-implementing and reinforcing discrimination already existing in our societies. This is in line with the concept of “Fairness by Design" proposed by BIBREF31.
